name: Ammonium chloride qualitative analysis pilot
description: Three separate close-up tests using the existing ammonium-chloride starting images. Short cards explain observations between generated clips.
subject: Chemistry
educational_goal: Illustrate ammonium and chloride confirmatory observations with short, single-action clips.

metadata.title_text:
Ammonium ion test
NaOH, then an HCl-dipped rod

scene.scene: One glass tube containing ammonium chloride crystals with a clear sodium hydroxide dropper above it.

prompt_bundle.motion_prompt: Use the exact starting image. One clear drop falls from the existing dropper onto the white salt in the same glass tube. Keep the tube, clamp and camera fixed. The liquid wets the crystals; do not show visible fumes yet. Only this one action occurs.
prompt_bundle.negative_prompt: extra tube, new dropper, colored liquid, flames, boiling, thick smoke, white fumes, precipitate, camera movement, zoom, text

scene.scene: The same ammonium salt and NaOH tube, following gentle warming between shots. Ammonia gas is invisible.

prompt_bundle.motion_prompt: Continue from the exact last frame of the previous clip. A thin glass rod dipped in hydrochloric acid approaches the mouth of the same test tube from the left. A small patch of white ammonium chloride fumes appears only near the rod tip where it meets the invisible ammonia gas. Keep the tube, clamp and camera fixed. One slow approach, then hold.
prompt_bundle.negative_prompt: fumes before rod arrives, smoke from salt, flame, boiling, new tube, extra apparatus, colored gas, dramatic cloud, pan, zoom, text

metadata.title_text:
Ammonium ion: Nessler spot test
Orange-brown precipitate

scene.scene: A separate vessel holding clear ammonium chloride water extract, with a pale-yellow Nessler reagent dropper above it.

prompt_bundle.motion_prompt: Use the exact starting image. One pale-yellow drop falls from the existing dropper into the clear ammonium salt extract. A small orange-brown precipitate appears where the drop enters and remains in the same vessel. Keep the dropper, vessel and camera fixed. Show only one drop and the local color change.
prompt_bundle.negative_prompt: gas tubing, new vessel, additional droppers, large explosion of color, black solid, flames, shaking, zoom, pan, text

metadata.title_text:
Chloride ion test
Silver nitrate, then ammonia solution

scene.scene: A separate glass tube holding clear ammonium chloride water extract with a silver nitrate dropper above it.

prompt_bundle.motion_prompt: Use the exact starting image. One clear silver nitrate drop falls from the existing dropper into the same clear salt extract. A small curdy white silver chloride precipitate appears near the drop and remains visible. Keep the tube, stand, hand and camera fixed. One drop, then hold.
prompt_bundle.negative_prompt: extra tube, extra hand, colored solid, yellow precipitate, smoke, flames, vigorous motion, zoom, pan, text

metadata.title_text:
Next: add dilute ammonia solution
The white precipitate dissolves

scene.scene: The same glass tube now contains the curdy white silver chloride precipitate.

prompt_bundle.motion_prompt: Continue from the exact last frame of the silver nitrate clip. Dilute ammonia solution was added to this same tube between shots. The existing white precipitate gradually thins and dissolves, leaving a clearer liquid. The dropper does not release another drop. Keep the tube, stand, hand and camera fixed. Show only this gradual change.
prompt_bundle.negative_prompt: new tube, falling drop, more white precipitate, colored liquid, smoke, flames, shaking, zoom, pan, text
